name: penpot-core-skills
description: Centralized agentic design skills for Penpot and the Penpot MCP: token/library foundation, component variants, screen building (from brief and from code), slide decks (1920x1080 boards + playable flows), accessibility and token-governance audits, design-to-code review, handoff documentation, DESIGN.md extraction, Figma migration, semantic renaming, and a router. Grounded in the real Penpot MCP surface (4 core tools, plus import_image in local mode).

skills.name: penpot-router
skills.description: Thin dispatcher: route any Penpot request to exactly one skill or workflow.

skills.name: penpot-foundations
skills.description: Token + library foundation: primitive/semantic/component tiers, themes, infer-from-design.

skills.name: penpot-component-factory
skills.description: Components with complete, tokenized variant matrices and all interactive states.

skills.name: penpot-build-screen
skills.description: Design production-grade screens from a brief, reusing the system, section by section.

skills.name: penpot-build-from-code
skills.description: Translate app code/pages into an on-system Penpot screen bound to tokens.

skills.name: penpot-build-deck
skills.description: Design a slide deck from a brief: 1920x1080 slide boards, one per call, deck tokens, varied archetypes, playable View-mode flow, PDF-ready.

skills.name: penpot-document-handoff
skills.description: Document a design for handoff: a hideable annotation layer beside the design (context card, numbered pins, matching observation notes, tooltips), reusing or creating an annotation component kit + tokens.

skills.name: penpot-audit-accessibility
skills.description: WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA audit: contrast, target size, semantics, focus order.

skills.name: penpot-audit-tokens
skills.description: Token governance audit: hardcoded values, off-grid spacing, orphan/duplicate tokens.

skills.name: penpot-design-to-code-review
skills.description: Extract Penpot markup/style and report drift vs source component/Storybook.

skills.name: penpot-migrate
skills.description: Figma -> Penpot migration via an intermediate representation: Auto Layout->flex, Variables->tokens, sets->variants.

skills.name: penpot-rename-layers
skills.description: Rename layers to semantic HTML names; precondition for audits and code review.

skills.name: penpot-design-md
skills.description: Extract a portable DESIGN.md spec from the file's real tokens, assets and sampled components. Read-only; writes one local markdown file.

skills.name: kmp-router
skills.description: Thin dispatcher for KMP build work: compute the routing decision into .kmp/route.json and name exactly one target skill.

skills.name: kmp-domain-model
skills.description: Model a capability's domain with Coad's Color Modeling (Moment-Intervals first, then Roles, Parties/Places/Things, Descriptions) and map it onto the kit. Produces openspec/changes/<id>/domain.md.

skills.name: kmp-init
skills.description: Scaffold a new runnable Kotlin Multiplatform app from the vendored template and wire it for OpenSpec, the checker and the KMP subagents.

skills.name: kmp-create-feature
skills.description: Create a complete KMP Clean Architecture feature from an OpenSpec spec and a Penpot design, layer by layer with checkpoints.

skills.name: kmp-modify-feature
skills.description: Change an existing KMP feature spec-first: draft the OpenSpec spec delta, get approval, then implement behind the feature guard.

skills.name: kmp-review-feature
skills.description: Audit a KMP feature: consume the deterministic checker report, then review the judgment rules, spec compliance and UI file organization. Read-only.

skills.name: kmp-test-feature
skills.description: Generate a KMP feature's test suite in dependency order: fixtures, data-layer, then ViewModel/UI/integration, staged through subagents.

skills.name: kmp-bridge-swift
skills.description: Bridge the iOS side when an expect/actual needs real Swift — native framework wrappers or UIKit views — behind a thin interop surface.

skills.name: kmp-using-design-system
skills.description: UI guard: reuse an existing X* component and its tokens before authoring anything new, and never hardcode a color, size, or string.

skills.name: kmp-domain-recon
skills.description: FDD steps 1-2 for a new project: interview, split the domain into areas, and write the living vocabulary plus a selectable feature list.
